title: Source Snow steps in the motorcycle scene batch
summary: The shared source-camera Snow manager now advances within motorcycle scene batches on Caribou Race. Host browser checks retained the source scene texture and Snow state through pause, physical reset, fixed-clock operation, and graphics-context restoration.
details: Across the combined build, all 40 venue routes loaded ambient declarations and weather selection metadata; seven rain lifecycle cases and ENV05 ATV/motorcycle fountain lifecycle and buffer checks passed. Source Caribou Race Snow ATV rechecks also passed in desktop and portrait.

For this host-only ATV2 scene Snow capture with the optional source-based motorcycle extension, desktop and 390×844 portrait runs each used 60 rings, 27 active emitters, one draw and 508,016 GPU bytes; render-only uploads were zero, and the fixed-clock reset and restored Snow framebuffer checks passed exactly. This run's changed-pixel counts were 43,621 desktop and 49,629 portrait; those clock/camera-dependent pixel areas are evidence of contribution, not a performance benchmark.

Snow continues to sample the scene GPU material and texture when the motorcycle tire atlas is loaded; it does not use the vehicle atlas for Snow. The inspected portrait screenshot is an automated host Chromium race-preview view with the GO overlay visible, not a physical-phone capture.
limitation: The component remains bounded source-derived browser behavior, not full original weather or PS2 parity. Shared global RNG and render-queue provenance remain open; source fog type 12 and moving train smoke are unfinished. No public release is claimed here.
caption: Host Chromium portrait (390×844): original Caribou Race Snow around the motorcycle scene, with the Race preview GO overlay; automated browser capture, not a physical phone.
